annotations.title: Check a name against CAC's register

description: Search CAC's public register for names matching or similar to a name, across every registration type (business names, companies, LLPs, trustees), ranked like fastcac.com's public search. CAC rejects a new name that's too close to any of them, active or inactive. `exact_match` is the registered name that is this name (case, spacing and the legal form like Ltd ignored), or null. close_matches come best first, each with `match` (exact, close, similar, or null when it only shares a distinctive word); a close match is often the same name with another ending (ADAEZE ENTERPRISES for "Adaeze Ventures"), which CAC treats as a clash. Lead with exact_match when there is one; when it's null, say nothing is registered under this exact name and lead with the closest matches as the clash they are. Any close match means the name is at risk; CAC makes the final call (check_business_name_compliance asks it). For an RC/BN number use search_cac_register instead.
name: check_name_availability

close_matches.description: Names that put this one at risk, best first.

match.description: How close the name is to the one searched (exact: the same name, legal form like Ltd ignored); results come best first.

rc_number.description: RC number (BN number for a business name).

status.description: CAC status, e.g. ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

exact_match.description: The registered name that IS this name (case, spacing and the legal form like Ltd ignored), or null. Lead with it when present; a close match is often the same name with another ending, which CAC treats as a clash.

likely_available.description: True when nothing on CAC's register is close (no exact, close or similar match, and none sharing a distinctive word). CAC still decides: check_business_name_compliance asks it.
